question: What protocol is commonly used for sending and receiving emails?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2) SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol)** is the protocol used for sending emails.
 
• It is a part of the application layer of the TCP/IP protocol suite.
 
• SMTP is used to transfer messages from the sender's email client to the recipient's email server.
